subject.title: [Feature]: Add a visible browser panel to the Control UI for login handoff and browser management

question: What minimal host-owned browser handoff scope should OpenClaw implement first for managed-browser login workflows?
rationale: The issue crosses UX, browser-state exposure, auth/session persistence, redaction, and resume semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design minimal host-owned handoff
options.body: Add only the status, exact managed-session access, login-required state, and resume affordance needed for same-browser-state authentication first.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI infrastructure
options.body: Defer implementation until generic plugin UI entry points settle, then decide whether browser management belongs as plugin-owned UI or core-hosted UI.

options.title: Decline core handoff panel
options.body: Keep browser visibility outside the Control UI and accept that authenticated browser workflows remain harder to recover.

recommendation.title: Design minimal host-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Add only the status, exact managed-session access, login-required state, and resume affordance needed for same-browser-state authentication first.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the canonical product-scope comment for this issue, making him the clearest available owner for the product direction choice.
